metadata.note: Each image is one product+color combo. Sizes do not need separate images.

variant_image_linking.how: Reads this manifest, matches each variant by its color attribute, sets image_variant_1920 (base64) on the variant; template image_1920 gets the first color
variant_image_linking.triggered_when: Only when demo data is being installed (install_demo context)

workflow: 1. Edit products in PRODUCTS dict of generate_products.py if needed
2. Run generate_products.py to regenerate XML files and this manifest
3. Pick a category and run generate_images.py <category_key>
5. Reinstall the module (or run post_init hook) to link images to variants
metadata.regeneration_warning: Running generate_products.py overwrites this manifest and resets all statuses to pending. Re-running generate_images.py for already-done images is wasteful. Back up the manifest before regenerating, or only regenerate if structural changes are needed.

steps: 2. Force pixels with R,G,B > 245 to pure (255,255,255)
3. Find product bbox via non-white pixels
5. Scale longest side to 75% of 512, cap upscale at 1.5x
6. Paste centered on 512x512 pure white canvas
7. Final sweep: force any remaining near-white to (255,255,255)

tried_and_rejected.stability-ai/stable-diffusion-3: mixed bag, not better than Pro
tried_and_rejected.851-labs/background-remover: extra cost not worth it when Pro already gives near-white

workflow_per_category: 2. Delete any bad final image (no need to delete the raw)
4. Script auto-deletes stale raw + regenerates with Pro + post-processes
Special: re-apply post-process to ALL existing raws without API calls:
